name: variable_isolation
description: Engine validation: variables set by an earlier test must not leak into this test (per-test variable scoping)

test_steps.desc: Set a sentinel only this test should see
Confirm this test own variable is substituted
test_steps.guest_run: if ('@isolation_sentinel@' -eq 'isolation_ok') { Write-Output 'PASS: own variable substituted' } else { Write-Output 'FAIL: own variable not substituted'; exit 1 }

test_steps.desc: Confirm the earlier test variable did NOT leak (placeholder stays literal)
test_steps.guest_run: $ph = '@test_' + 'value@'; if ('@test_value@' -eq $ph) { Write-Output 'PASS: previous test variable isolated' } else { Write-Output ('FAIL: leaked previous variable: ' + '@test_value@'); exit 1 }
